Summarise invasiveness/invasibility

Source: R/summarise_results.R
summarise_results.Rd

Thin wrapper over summarise_invasiveness_invasibility().

Usage

summarise_results(
  fit,
  boundary_sf = NULL,
  boundary_params = list(inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.3),
  traits_inv = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

fit

object with $fitness and/or $prob.

boundary_sf

An sf object to overlay as a boundary on the site map.

boundary_params

Named list of aesthetics for ggplot2::geom_sf; defaults to list(inherit.aes=FALSE, fill=NA, color="black", size=0.3).

...

forwarded to summarise_invasiveness_invasibility().

Value

updated invasimapr_fit
